5226-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5226-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

339-574-677-7060.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-7060.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2438-2586-3197.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat

1339-1832-2324-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2324-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2811-4499-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

34-141-728.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-728.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3899-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3899-5972-6054.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

277-851-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-3734.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-3734.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-3734.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

997-1619-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

549-3259-5953-7292.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-7292.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-7292.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3457-4785-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
3457-4785-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

851-3028-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-3028-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2762-4659-6872.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.

1263-4050-5632.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1270-1563-2457-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-997-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-5632.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3197-4304-5929.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Leyline of Transformation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Leyline of Transformation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

186-3789-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
186-3789-4131.description:
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2633-3440-4867-5256.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cormela's power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-844-951-2232-2972.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {1}{R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Shivan Devastator for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

353-2034-4055.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-2034-4055.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-2034-4055.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding six {C}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Energy Refractor three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

1003-2459-3156-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Rograkh.
Phyrexian Walker dies, triggering Koll, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

313-3542-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
313-3542-4050.description:
Activate up to fiva mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding {B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
Repeat.

1395-1594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

224-1257-5233.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

579-1247-2464.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
579-1247-2464.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.
